entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Boring properties in BCL collections should have `[DebuggerBrowsable(DebuggerBrowsableState.Never)]` #129952
  • [NativeAOT Arm64] Opportunistic light-up for Atomics instructions #129951
  • Consider adding `[NonVersionable]` to OS and process architecture getters. #129949
  • [API Proposal]: NetworkChange.IsSupported #129943
  • MemoryMappedFile Add some method or mechanism to refresh the underlying file size. #129940
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: KmacXof128Tests throw "invalid key length" under libraries-pgo #129939
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: AsyncProfilerTests.StateMachineAsync_CallstackStressWithVaryingDepths under libraries-jitstress #129938
  • [ci-scan] Build break: NativeAOT linker alignment error in PhysicalPromotion test (arm64) #129936

Closed

  • ChaCha20Poly1305 errors #129945
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: JIT assert "No IL header; cannot get EH info for function" under jitstress2 #129937
  • Crash in MethodTable::MethodDataObject::FillEntryDataForAncestor #119761
    11.0.0
  • DiagnosticsTest Http2 SendAsync_Success_ConnectionSetupActivityGraphRecorded: Unexpected EOF trying to read request header #129771
    11.0.0
